changelog: - **Exported revision and proposal files carry only valid project details.** The title, author and dates a project keeps were read back from this browser's saved work after only a minimal check, so a saved record that had been altered outside the app could put anything into every file exported from it — wrong kinds of values, unknown entries, an author name or note longer than the limits, even very large text. They are now checked by the same rules as an imported file: only the known details, of the right kind, with the author name and note shortened to their limits. Files from a normal project export exactly as before.
